Original Tracks’ Compatibility and Quality - 3: Like the previous 2 songs, these ones have a similar "feel", and it works well in your favor! Arrangements and Transitions - 2: Sadly, the song sounds overall a bit dissonant, especially towards the end, with a very odd-sounding pre-outro. Key and Tempo - 2: The vocals are still a bit off-beat (see 0:35-0:45, the last 30s and the chorus), showing the same problems as the first submission. Overall, it still shows the same problems as your earlier submission, so I'll have to give it the same grade.

Really solid all around. There were a couple of spots at the beginning that felt kind of iffy and off tempo, but by the time the chorus kicks in, it all just clicks and it works. It's clear the transitions got special attention here by how well they fit too. I also especially like the bridge. Still, the early part could do with some adjustments but it doesn't really take away from the whole.
